notes: Five separate full layout SVG/JSON pairs. Default board is Tower; use tableModel.modeLayouts to select an explicit other mode.
No app field/selector work is required to produce or understand these standalone assets.
No commercial logo or symbol illustration is copied; actual saved card fronts remain externally referenced.
The current English edition uses Triplet as fifth game. Older Catch Them All / themed variants are not silently mixed.

structureEvidence.location: p.1 all five game setup/play diagrams; p.2 physical card/component overview
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: 55 circular cards,8symbols each; Tower,Well,HotPotato,PoisonedGift,Triplet have different shared/player pile and transfer structures; Triplet3×3,HotPotato whole-hand-stack transfer and penalty rounds.

assetScope: All five Classic mini-game full tables and all 2–8 player piles/held stacks, rather than one generic centre and a selected-player strip. Assets only.

tableModel.edition: Classic ECO English rules dated 2023-02-24, hosted by official publisher in2025; fifth mini-game is The Triplet, not older alternate rule sets

cardInventory.reproduction: physical card identities/front images come from the actual saved card reference or existing dedicated art; this asset does not invent/reproduce a 55-card symbol incidence list

coordinates.disc: circle centre/radius; full physical card uses an explicit instance ID and rotation
coordinates.piles: ordered ids bottom-to-top; offset is a visual pile example, not maximum height

pileRoles.setup: one face-down card per player; remaining cards face-up in the centre
pileRoles.playerPile: personal collected face-up pile; current top is its active card
pileRoles.transfer: centre top to claiming player personal pile

pileRoles.setup: one face-up centre card; remaining cards divided into player piles face-down, then all piles turned face-up at start
pileRoles.playerPile: personal face-up cards still to shed
pileRoles.transfer: own personal top onto centre pile

pileRoles.setup: one face-down card per player per round; unused cards set aside for later rounds
pileRoles.playerPile: held card stack in palm, only top used for matching; round loser accumulates a separate penalty pile
pileRoles.transfer: all held cards as one ordered stack onto another player held stack
pileRoles.goal: fewest penalty cards after chosen rounds (at least five)

pileRoles.setup: one face-down card per player; remaining cards face-up in centre
pileRoles.playerPile: personal receiving pile; top is active target
pileRoles.transfer: centre top onto another player personal pile

pileRoles.setup: face-down shared deck; reveal nine cards in a 3×3 arrangement
pileRoles.playerPile: collected triplets, no personal active matching card
pileRoles.centerPile: nine individual public positions, plus separate hidden reserve deck
pileRoles.transfer: three cards sharing the same single symbol across all three move to finder; refill those positions if possible

tableModel.visibility: Cards remain face-down until the mode start reveal. Face-up active tops are public. Buried identities/order or unseen reserve cards remain unknown unless actually recorded; do not solve the hidden deck from symbol combinatorics.
tableModel.simultaneousPlay: No fictitious sequential active-player turn. Preserve paused hands/held stacks and an unresolved claim/transfer. The match between card values is not an automatic chronology decision.
tableModel.tripletConstraint: A valid Triplet claim uses one same symbol present on all three cards. Three pairwise matches with different symbols are not credited automatically. This asset records a claim but does not adjudicate it.
tableModel.hotPotatoStack: Transfer the entire palm stack, preserving its order, rather than only the visible top. Penalized cards accumulate outside the active palm for later rounds.

fieldBindings.hidden.scene: reserve deck physical metadata; no public front leakage

tableModel.ruleAutomation: No visual symbol recognition, claim priority, scoring, tie adjudication or live time sequencing is executed.

completeStructures: Tower shared draw and all personal tops
Well central receiving and all personal shedding piles
Hot Potato all held stacks, penalty piles and unused reserve
Poisoned Gift shared draw and all target receiving piles
Triplet nine circular positions, hidden reserve and all collected-triplet piles
all-player face, order, transfer, round and claim state
diagramOnly: circle silhouettes are pile/physical-card templates, not actual face symbols or setup card counts
Hot Potato five progress dots express minimum suggested rounds, not a hard maximum
